stem: Which phrase best represents the U.S. principle of republicanism?

options.label: F
options.text: The creation of a Congress to carry out the will of the people

options.label: G
options.text: The establishment of courts to interpret laws and government actions

options.label: H
options.text: The division of power between a federal government and state governments

options.label: J
options.text: The power of a court to declare a law unconstitutional
